response.sql:
WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS average_unit_price
  FROM Products
  GROUP BY production_type_code
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_average_unit_price
  FROM Products
),
first_kept AS (
  SELECT t.production_type_code, t.average_unit_price, b.overall_average_unit_price
  FROM type_averages t
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE b.overall_average_unit_price IS NOT NULL
    AND t.average_unit_price > b.overall_average_unit_price
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_unit_price) AS mean_kept_type_average
  FROM first_kept
),
remaining AS (
  SELECT f.average_unit_price, f.overall_average_unit_price, m.mean_kept_type_average
  FROM first_kept f
  CROSS JOIN first_mean m
  WHERE f.average_unit_price > m.mean_kept_type_average
)
SELECT AVG(average_unit_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(average_unit_price - overall_average_unit_price) AS average_above_overall_baseline,
       AVG(average_unit_price - mean_kept_type_average) AS average_above_mean_of_first_kept_types
FROM remaining;

assumptions.assumption: A type with no non-NULL unit prices has a NULL average and is excluded; averages and thresholds use the database's native AVG semantics.
